utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Ira, are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, still on—I’m just running a couple errands first, then I’ll swing by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time do you think you’ll be here?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks, Gus. I’ll swing by and see what else we still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — I’ll keep the tools ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together nicely—people have been dropping off all kinds of things. I can swing by later and see what else they still need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help a lot—I'm just worried about what still needs to be sorted and whether we have room for everything. If you stop by, could you check what’s left and tell me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll stop by and check what’s left, then let you know if they’re running short on space. I’ll bring back the latest news for you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you check in at the repair drive site on Maple Street and help direct folks to the donation table?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can head to Maple Street and help direct people to the donation table.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to send you the details?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, please send them over. Thanks, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the details right over!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m putting the repair drive details in order now. What part do you want to tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can handle tool collection first. I’ll sort the screwdrivers and tape.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Leo — that’s a huge help. I’ll set aside a labeled box for the screwdrivers and tape so everything stays together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m listening—what details should I double-check for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Could you double-check the start time and the tool list? I may join late, so I want to be sure I have what I need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure—I’ll verify the start time and the tool list, and I’ll make sure to pass them along clearly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule if that makes the repair drive easier. What’s the timing looking like?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a huge help, Faye — thank you. I’m still pulling the timing together, but I’ll check what works best around school pickup and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — just send me the times when you know them, and I’ll work around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive so far—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s shaping up nicely — folks are still dropping off tools and a few volunteers are sorting the donations. I can fill you in on the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great—what still needs to be sorted?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still okay to bring the repair drive by this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still good to bring it by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard much yet, but I’m glad the repair drive is happening. If you want, I can help spread the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be great, Rey—thank you. I’ll keep my ears open and try not to forget the details this time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No worries, Oren — just let me know the details when you have them, and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep a running list of supplies so we can see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep telling neighbors and point them to your list so we stay on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good timing—how’s the repair drive going so far?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s going okay so far—still a few things left to sort out. I’ve mostly been listening and helping where I can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like it’s moving along. Let me know if you need anything while you’re out there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, though I may need a reminder on what’s already been arranged.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’ll keep you posted on what’s already been arranged and repeat the plan as we go.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — that’d help a lot. I’m ready to pitch in wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I may have missed the details, but I’m in if you need another hand.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Noah — that helps a lot. I’ll send the details and timing when I have them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — just let me know when you’ve got the timing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll make a clear list and bring it by tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll have the tools ready for you. Bring the list by tomorrow morning and we’ll get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn — I’m in for the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or help with?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Amazing, Mara — thank you! If you can bring a small toolbox and a few gloves, that would be perfect; I’ll send the exact time and place as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll bring a small toolbox and a few gloves. Just send the time and place when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help out with the repair drive—want me to spread the word or bring something by?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you spread the word first? If you can, also bring a box of tape and markers by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and I can bring a box of tape and markers by the community center too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m getting the repair drive organized and I’d love your help. When you have a minute, can we go over what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, Rosa — I can help with that. Let’s go over what still needs fixing and I’ll keep track of the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — that’s a huge help. I’ve got a few items to sort through, and I’ll walk you through them now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive was getting a good turnout—do you know if they still need any help?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m not sure yet, but I can check. What kind of help do they still need?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mina — if they still need anything, I can help with sorting donations or carrying things.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what still needs fixing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mostly the folding tables, a couple of chairs, and the sign by the front gate. If we can get those sorted before Friday, we’ll be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can help with the tables and chairs. Who’s handling the sign?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Could you confirm you’re actually bringing the tools and not just stopping by?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’m bringing the tools and I’ll stay to help with the repairs.
